[type]
Lexer

[grammar]
lexer grammar L;
LBrace : '{' ;
RBrace : '}' ;
Inbetween : ~'}' ;

[input]
"""{foo}"""

[output]
[@0,0:0='{',<1>,1:0]
[@1,1:1='f',<3>,1:1]
[@2,2:2='o',<3>,1:2]
[@3,3:3='o',<3>,1:3]
[@4,4:4='}',<2>,1:4]
[@5,5:4='<EOF>',<-1>,1:5]
[output type=lexer-only-named-types]
[@0,0:0='{',<LBrace>,channel=0,1:0]
[@1,1:1='f',<Inbetween>,channel=0,1:1]
[@2,2:2='o',<Inbetween>,channel=0,1:2]
[@3,3:3='o',<Inbetween>,channel=0,1:3]
[@4,4:4='}',<RBrace>,channel=0,1:4]
[@5,5:4='<EOF>',<EOF>,channel=0,1:5]
[input name=B]
"""{bar}"""

[output name=B]
[@0,0:0='{',<1>,1:0]
[@1,1:1='b',<3>,1:1]
[@2,2:2='a',<3>,1:2]
[@3,3:3='r',<3>,1:3]
[@4,4:4='}',<2>,1:4]
[@5,5:4='<EOF>',<-1>,1:5]
[output name=B type=lexer-only-named-types]
[@0,0:0='{',<LBrace>,channel=0,1:0]
[@1,1:1='b',<Inbetween>,channel=0,1:1]
[@2,2:2='a',<Inbetween>,channel=0,1:2]
[@3,3:3='r',<Inbetween>,channel=0,1:3]
[@4,4:4='}',<RBrace>,channel=0,1:4]
[@5,5:4='<EOF>',<EOF>,channel=0,1:5]
